testcase.name: Scenario: Apply staged commands for two ribbon targets together: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:562:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Apply staged commands for two ribbon targets together ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the Tools ribbon visible ✔ And the Part Tools and Part Manage custom panel lists are initially empty ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog shows the Part Tools target and All Commands ✔ When the user adds "2D Sketches" to the Part Tools custom panel ✔ And the user selects the Part Manage target ✔ And the user adds "3D Annotations" to its custom panel ✔ And the user clicks Apply ✔ Then the customization dialog remains open on the Part Manage target ✔ And its list contains "3D Annotations" without a pending-change marker ✔ And Apply and cancels are disabled ✔ And the Tools ribbon displays a User Commands panel ✔ When the user selects the Part Tools target ✔ Then its list contains "2D Sketches" without a pending-change marker
